evidence.location: company outline, 1983 establishment and 1989 brand start
evidence.limit: Alicesoft brand started in 1989, so Champion Soft products in 1982–88 cannot be relabelled as contemporary Alicesoft-branded development.

evidence.location: free-distribution list, three named Showa Champion Soft products
evidence.limit: Little Princess, Little Vampire and Gakuen Senki are explicitly Champion Soft brand products; the text does not assign the later Alicesoft brand development.

evidence.location: official System 3.8/3.9 compatibility list, five Alice Blue titles and Nor
evidence.limit: The page names Alice Blue and Alice Noir on individual titles; it is a product/engine list, not evidence that the parent brand independently made all components.

evidence.location: Nor contemporary product page and development diary
evidence.limit: The product identifies AliceNoir as its first release; this does not resolve a parent Alicesoft production credit.

evidence.location: 2020-07-22 original director announcement, introduction and new-brand paragraphs
evidence.limit: The director calls IMYUIC an Alicesoft-produced new brand for this specific game; credits are limited to production collaboration, not independent engine/programming.

evidence.location: 2022-05-30 separation announcement, name and ongoing sale paragraphs
evidence.limit: Later IMYUIC(ALICESOFT) sale name and independence cannot be projected backward as sole original development.
